items.question: Who can enter?
items.answer: Guests with a foreign passport. Bring it with you; reception checks it before you go onto the floor.

items.question: Is there an entry fee?
items.answer: No. Entry is free, and every guest receives an INR 1,000 entry coupon.

items.question: Can you collect me from my hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Pickup and drop between your hotel and the casino is free. Call +977 970 505 5910 to arrange it.

items.question: Can I eat at the casino?
items.answer: Yes. The buffet serves lunch and dinner on the gaming floor, and drinks are served at the tables.

items.question: Can I stay nearby?
items.answer: The casino is in the grounds of Grand Hotel Kathmandu. The VIP package includes a room.
